Artificial Intelligence also known for it's short form AI is a man created intelligence consisting of millions of data-structures and patterns. AI is created by making a machine learn abont different types of data structures, patterns and algorithms. It was created to help us humans in our varions works. There are a dozen of AI each working for different purposes equipped with different features. But the most common one among them are AI chatbots. AI chatbots can communicate and converse like a real human being. Beconse of it having access to a large amounut of data, it can answer almost every question, can do any and solve any math problems. It is safe to say that AI chatbots are the ones that revolutionized Artificial Intelligence. AI has many applications on humnan life. from daily lifestyle do work life AI can {inserted: be} applied everywhere. One can tell AI do make a daily routine for them and it will create a daily routine tailored just for them, It can also organize a person's daily chores, set up and iterate schedule etc.

AI has also revolutionized the teaching and learning sector. AI can solve any math problem faster than a man can, students are using AI as their personal tutor, to whom they can ask- any problem and get the solution. Teachers are using AI to eva evaluate students, creating personalized study materials for them which will help them grow. Despite it's merit AI can pose as a great threat to basic human growth. for that world leaders and leading researchers have put AI regulations in place to keep it from becoming a threat to humanity.
